nets: ATO valve load net (drain of T6)
anomalies.observed: In the 'ATO Valve' driver block the low-side switch is T6, an AO3400A (30 V, SOT-23) N-MOSFET, while the AON6407 (T5) is instead placed in the 24 V input 'Reverse polarity protection' position of the POWER TRAIN.
anomalies.expected: The specification assigns the AON6407 to the ATO solenoid-valve switch and does not describe an AON6407 in the input protection path (protection is F1 + D2 + Schottky flybacks). The valve switch should be the higher-voltage AON6407.

evidence.quote: T3 — AON6407 (8-DFN N-MOSFET) | ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch (Component Table); §3 'ATO solenoid valve (via T3/T4 switch, ATO_VALVE net)'
Page 1, 'ATO Valve' block: T6 = AO3400A as the low-side MOSFET (gate via R48/T3, drain to +24V via D5/H7); POWER TRAIN shows T5 = AON6407 labelled 'Reverse polarity protection'

anomalies.impact: The 24 V inductive ATO solenoid is switched by a 30 V, SOT-23 part instead of the intended 60 V AON6407. With the 24 V rail clamped at 28 V by the input TVS, the off-state drain voltage leaves only ~2 V headroom on the AO3400A's 30 V rating and the small package has poor thermal margin, so the valve driver is underspecified and prone to avalanche/over-temperature failure.

anomalies.observed: The TF-Luna LiDAR (PR4) is wired through header H9: pin1 to +5V, pin2 to NET0084 (I2C_SDA), pin3 to NET0063 (I2C_SCL), pin4 to GND (only TX/RX are no-connects).
anomalies.expected: The specification states the LiDAR is not implemented: 'all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design' and 'TF-Luna LiDAR is unwired'.

evidence.quote: §4.3 'the r2 netlist shows PR1 with on_board: no ... all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net in this design'; §6 'TF-Luna LiDAR is unwired'
Page 1, 'Water Level Sensor/Switches': PR4 LiDAR -> H9 with +5V, NET0084, NET0063, GND connected

anomalies.impact: A LiDAR module that the design (and firmware) treats as absent is connected to the +5V rail and the main I2C bus, adding an unmanaged 5V load and an extra I2C device (TF-Luna @0x10) to a bus the firmware does not expect, contrary to the documented 'not connected' state.

parsed.summary: Two deviations from the documented design are visible: the ATO solenoid valve is switched by a 30 V AO3400A (T6) rather than the specified 60 V AON6407 (which appears only in the reverse-polarity position), and the TF-Luna LiDAR (PR4), which the spec states is unwired with all pins free, is actually connected to +5V and the main I2C bus.
